decisions.reason: As a net price display plugin closely tied to the firm's shop customization work, it fits the core offer and is likely worth retaining unless demand proves very weak.
An ERP system interface plugin strengthens the firm's end-to-end e-commerce service and supports multichannel process integration, so management would be inclined to keep it.
A price comparison tracking plugin matches the firm's analytics and optimization focus, but this category is somewhat more at risk of portfolio cleanup if several similar plugins overlap.
This plugin also supports measurable marketing performance for online shops, so it remains strategically relevant even though overlap with similar tracking tools raises some pruning risk.
The product fits the firm's optimization business, but with multiple closely related price comparison tracking plugins in the range, management would watch uptake and may consolidate later.
A net price reporting plugin complements the firm's analytics-oriented services and proprietary extension strategy, making continued market presence more likely than withdrawal.
